title: HTTP resource lookup outlives its registry ownership
summary: indigo_server_tcp.c:408-424, PUT lookup500ff; remove584-596/free595, remove-all606-616. Snapshot/reference ownership and retire only after active response releases; coordinate handler unload lifetime. Root independently confirmed.
